root_cause: An older concurrent candidate introduced a second authenticated signal loader in the same Foresight mount, risking duplicate UI, stale async application and divergent tenant signal interpretations.
prevention: Re-use exactly one existing authenticated intelligence packet and tenant-authority checks. Filter scored signals and associated candidate actions together by risk/opportunity/development. Never turn scored signals into probabilities or numeric forecast inputs. Do not merge the obsolete parallel loader.

evidence.source: Merged V2 tenant evidence overlay from #4427
evidence.release_gate: Protected CI/CodeQL, exact SHA production deploy and authenticated tenant readback
